title.en: An Act Establishing in the City of Iloilo, Province of Iloilo, a City Hospital to Be Known as the Iloilo City Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing in the City of Iloilo, Province of Iloilo, a City Hospital to Be Known as the Iloilo City Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11891_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established in the City of Iloilo, Province of Iloilo, a tertiary general hospital to be known as the Iloilo City Hospital (ICH), which shall be under the direct control and supervision of the City Government of Iloilo.

The City Government of Iloilo shall manage the ICH, and prepare, in consultation with the Department of Health, a hospital development plan aligned with the Philippine Health Facility Development Plan. Any future increase in bed capacity, health care facilities, service capability, and human resource complement shall be based on the hospital development plan.

The amount of Five hundred million pesos (P500,000,000.00) is herby appropriated for the capital outlay of the ICH, which shall be included in the budget of the Department of Health under the 2023 General Appropriations Act. The City Government of Iloilo shall provide the funding for the operation and maintenance of the ICH.
If any provision or part of this Act is declared unconstitutional, the remaining parts or provisions not affected shall remain in full force and effect.
ll laws, executive orders, issuances, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
